description: Rulebook section anchors, p.75 index catalog, and entity-passage end rules. Boundaries are operator-maintained contract data (not hardcoded in Python): sections[].start_anchor/end_anchor for RULES mechanics and THE WORLD place/lore blocks; entity_passage.stop_before for CREATURES prose cuts between bestiary blocks. Optional sections[].content_source points at hand-authored files when PDF text is not usable (e.g. two-column name grid). text_filters strips running PDF headers/footers from the shared extract stream. passage_granularity subheading_regex + passage_split splits Roman/subsection titles inside a parent span. sections[].index_titles lists all RULES IndexEntry titles that MAPS_TO_SECTION the same Chunk (compound sections). sections[].seed_evidence=false blocks Chunk→SeedNode CONFIRMS_SEED/DOCUMENTED_BY (Briefing 21).

handoff.sync: This file is the only copy. Do not copy it into ADA corpus. See docs/ingest-manifest-sync.md.

text_filters.notes: Running header/footer on Bare Bones pages. Applied per page in the shared extract path (document_extract / section_chunking / table pipeline). Not table-specific — lives here, not ingest-manifest.

anchor_matching.notes: Whole-line regex anchors. Future: add min_font_size_ratio from PyMuPDF spans to disambiguate body mentions. Index page hints are not used for matching.

entity_passage.notes: Design: entity-scoped RulePassage boundaries live in this contract (same spirit as sections[] anchors and lookup_tables.pdf_extract.stop_before). Python only compiles/matches. Start = creature heading on page; end = min(next index title on page, first stop_before hit). Optional per creatures_index row: text_end_hint (exclusive literal or regex) when shared stop_before is wrong.

stop_before.notes: Label then silver tally, e.g. Head 7s / Captured 50-120s (...)
